title: Quick German Breakfast Hash
description: A simple and delicious German-inspired breakfast dish made with pan-fried hash browns, eggs, and sausage.
instructions: 1. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the shredded hash browns to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes.
6. Push the hash browns to one side of the skillet.
7. Pour the beaten eggs into the other side of the skillet and scramble until cooked through.
8. Mix the eggs with the hash browns.
9. Add the cooked sausage back into the skillet and stir to combine.
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
